values.meaning: tether duration before fracture / root duration

mechanics.claim: The initial hit deals damage to the first enemy hit and forms a tether between LeBlanc and the target for 1.5 seconds.
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy it hits and forms a {{tip|tether}} between '''LeBlanc''' and the target for {{fd|1.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, it deals a second, separate damage instance and roots the target.
mechanics.quote: If the tether is not broken by the end of its duration, it fractures to deal {{as|magic damage}} to the target and {{tip|root}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Both the initial and delayed damage instances can proc/detonate Sigil of Malice.
mechanics.quote: Both the initial and the delayed damage can detonate {{ai|Sigil of Malice|LeBlanc}}.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks the tether's application and initial damage, but not the delayed fracture damage of an already-applied tether.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the tether's application and initial damage but not the aftereffects of one already applied.
